text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert - solsticebridge-prod dedicated pool (canary slice) elevated 5xx rate + p95 latency spike. Paging oncall: emma.

emma (oncall): I see it, +50% 502s for the last 6m on canary traffic to dedicated-solstice pool. Customer reported timeouts too.

emma (oncall): jumping in — can we isolate the canary and pin back the previous artifact? @raj can you take lead on pinback?

raj (infra): on it. quick summary of what I'm seeing from infra: the canary was pinned to artifact a-2026-03-10-diffq. Errors are originating from model shard nodes 3/7 in dedicated-solstice. CPU not spiking but grpc connect errors. suspect regression in tokenization patch.

sylvie (eng-runtime): logs from the runtime show: ```
2026-03-10T21:12:03Z runtime ERROR request_id=fd3a4 ServiceError: kv-cache-miss -> fallback pipeline failed
2026-03-10T21:12:04Z runtime WARN  model_loader: failed to init optim kernels for artifact a-2026-03-10-diffq: mismatched op set
```

emma (oncall): ok that aligns. Action plan: (1) isolate canary traffic, (2) pin tenant back to stable artifact, (3) run smoke/health checks, (4) if green, unfreeze traffic. mike please prep comms for SolsticeBridge.

mike (support): drafting customer note. will send preliminary Slack DM and email once we have rollback started.

raj (infra): starting isolation. hitting the control plane now: ```bash
# divert canary -> 0% on dedicated-solstice
redwoodctl traffic-slice update --pool dedicated-solstice --slice canary --weight 0
```

incident-bot: action logged: traffic-slice.update by raj at 3380012360

kevin (sre): confirming network level — divert command accepted, traffic for canary dropped to 0% at edge. watchers: aws-alb health checks still show some 502s for a shard, likely draining.

raj (infra): pinback command queued: ```bash
redwoodctl artifact pin --tenant solsticebridge --pool dedicated-solstice --artifact stable-1.3.7 --reason "emergency pinback due to canary 5xx spike"
```

incident-bot: runbook step started: artifact.pin by raj at 3380012389

raj (infra): executing now. ETA ~35s for control-plane to roll artifact pointers.

raj (infra): deploy-bot: artifact pin completed for tenant=solsticebridge pool=dedicated-solstice -> stable-1.3.7 (commit sha: b7c9f1e)

sylvie (eng-runtime): starting smoke tests against pinned artifact endpoints. simple health and generation checks:
```bash
# health ping
curl -s -D - https://solsticebridge.api.redwood/v1/health | head -n 10
# sample generate
curl -s -X POST https://solsticebridge.api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"Hello world"}' | jq '.status'
```

sylvie (eng-runtime): first results: health=200, sample generate returned status OK, latency p95 220ms (was 800-1200ms on canary).

emma (oncall): good. verify more shards are healthy. can you tail the runtime logs for the previously failing shards?

sylvie (eng-runtime): tailing now. logs show successful kernel init for artifact stable-1.3.7, no kv-cache errors. sample load across shards looks balanced.

mike (support): customer DM to SolsticeBridge sent: "We're rolling back the canary artifact to the previous stable version and diverting canary traffic. We'll confirm when traffic has been restored. Apologies for the interruption. Updating in ~15m."

solstice-ops (customer): thanks for the quick response. we're seeing improvement on our end too. please keep us posted.

raj (infra): edge metrics show 5xx rate back down to baseline within 90s of pinback. draining period completed.

kevin (sre): running extended smoke harness across 10k synthetic requests -> pass: 99.98% success, p95 250ms. No more node-level grpc failures.

emma (oncall): ok ready to unfreeze traffic. plan: re-enable canary at safe 5% gradually after 10m observation, but given customer impact we'll prefer to keep canary at 0% and mark canary artifact as disabled for this pool for now. decision?

raj (infra): recommend disabling canary auto-roll for dedicated-solstice and flag artifact a-2026-03-10-diffq for model team. I'll file a follow-up.

emma (oncall): agreed. raj please create follow-up ticket: include logs, failing nodes, artifact id, and suggestion to revert tokenization patch. sylvie take ownership for regression triage.

raj (infra): created ticket RW-INC-2026-781 (Pinned regression triage) and linked the artifact and logs. assigning to @sylvie.

sylvie (eng-runtime): ack. I'll start a bisection with model team tomorrow morning PST.

mike (support): customer update: "We rolled the service back to a stable version and isolated canary traffic. We expect normal behavior. Our team will follow up with a detailed incident summary." sent to SolsticeBridge.

solstice-ops (customer): confirmed — performance back to normal, thanks.

emma (oncall): final checklist: incident declared resolved, oncall handoff notes in RW-INC-2026-781, disable auto-roll for dedicated-solstice, alert thresholds to be tuned for canary. any objections?

kevin (sre): none. closing oncall for now.

emma (oncall): closing thread. :white_check_mark: Thanks all.

incident-bot: incident resolved and annotated with RW-INC-2026-781 at 3380012468"}
